reuse.why: Uses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse and extracts finishAccountLink/unlinkAccountLocally, but the new Fintegra link and download functions re-copy the provider boilerplate instead of factoring the shared upgrade-or-insert and download paths.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the upgrade-or-insert-account-plus-payee block that already exists five times, and downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the Akahu/Enable Banking download body.

placement.why: Link rules sit in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, the download in accounts/sync.ts dispatch, server URL in server-config and the type under types/models, matching the tree's layout.

scope.why: Edits serve the four steps; the finishAccountLink extraction across existing providers is a small related cleanup.

maintainability.why: The link-guard rules live in one helper used by all six providers, which is good, but that helper named assert... also performs a closed-account check and unlinks another account as a side effect, and the per-provider link bodies remain a sixfold copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link handler, including Fintegra, calls assertBankAccountNotLinked and finishAccountLink; no existing helper is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (sync.ts) are compressed/reformatted copies of the existing provider link and Enable Banking download bodies (collapsed objects, inlined destructuring), so the copy is reshaped rather than shared.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts: gains the replaceExistingLink flag (step 4), an upgradingId closed-account branch (step 3) and a replace-and-unlink branch (step 4), turning an assertion into a check-and-mutate helper.
